description: This C# source file defines logging categories and provides a static host class for accessing various loggers within the PDFsharp library, specifically for categories like document processing, image processing, font management, and PDF reading.

classes.name: PdfSharpLogCategory
classes.description: Defines string constants for different logging categories used within PDFsharp.

classes.name: PdfSharpLogHost
classes.description: Provides static properties and methods to access and manage loggers for various categories in PDFsharp.

methods.name: Logger
methods.description: Returns the general PDFsharp logger from LogHost.

methods.name: DocumentProcessingLogger
methods.description: Returns the logger dedicated to document processing activities.

methods.name: ImageProcessingLogger
methods.description: Returns the logger dedicated to image processing activities.

methods.name: FontManagementLogger
methods.description: Returns the logger dedicated to font management activities.

methods.name: PdfReadingLogger
methods.description: Returns the logger dedicated to PDF reading activities.

methods.name: CheckFactoryHasChanged
methods.description: Checks if the logging factory has been changed and resets loggers accordingly.

methods.name: ResetLogging
methods.description: Resets all category-specific loggers to default, typically called after a change in the global factory.
